all7_written_types_and_body_hashes.complete_written_type:
theorem scale_log_bounds
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigma) :
    1 ≤ 1 + Real.log d.scale ∧
      0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (2 * d.V) ∧
      1 + Real.log (2 * d.V) ≤ 2 * (1 + Real.log d.scale) ∧
      0 ≤ 1 + Real.log d.physicalFactorCap ∧
      1 + Real.log d.physicalFactorCap ≤ 4 * (1 + Real.log d.scale)

theorem constant_pos_and_uniform (B : ℕ) :
    0 < principalEnergyPolylogConstant B ∧
      ∀ (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
        MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → 0 ≤ sigma →
        CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * principalEnergy d ≤
          principalEnergyPolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 *
            (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (betaLogExponent B + 32)
